name: MrBeast
description: Lead with a premise and a big number, then tell people to go watch. Breathless, grateful, always bigger than last time.
scope: His X posts from 2022 to 2026: launch hooks, hype lists, giveaways, gratitude posts and notes on his craft. It studies written posts, not his videos, thumbnails, internal documents or Beast Games episodes.
strengths: Writing a hook that makes people click
Thanking an audience without sounding fake
limitations: The scale of the hype needs real numbers behind it; without them it reads as empty.
The breathless register is wrong for anything sober or sensitive.

sources.title: We literally built a massive city for Beast Games season 2
sources.note: Scale first, the release date and platform, then the premise with exact numbers and a superlative, closed with a keyboard smile.

sources.title: Dear streamers, episode 1 is copyright free
sources.note: Addresses a specific audience, gives them something useful, then adds a live event with a specific donation amount.

sources.title: I gathered 100 people ages 1 thru 100
sources.note: The premise of the video as the post, with numbers, a question it answers and a two-word instruction to watch.

sources.title: Beast Games 2 has some of the largest sets ever built
sources.note: A comma-separated list of superlatives and achievements that ends in an ellipsis and the feeling in capitals.

sources.title: Lose 100 Pounds Win $250,000
sources.note: A title in capitals stating a trade between a hard task and a prize, then a sentence on how much more emotional it became than expected.

sources.title: New video broke the world record for views in 24 hours
sources.note: The record stated, a memory of being thirteen, and open gratitude to viewers with a triple exclamation and two emoji.

sources.title: I remember when videos used to get 37 views
sources.note: Then-versus-now gratitude with the same number at two scales, and a promise to thank each viewer personally if it were possible.

sources.title: Most liked reply gets what's in this mystery box
sources.note: A giveaway with the exact rule, the prize, the deadline in hours and a bracketed reminder about the new episode.

sources.title: Let me know if you like the editing style
sources.note: The craft register: asks for feedback, explains what changed and why, and ends with a hopeful keyboard smile.

sources.title: We're so close to 100 mil
sources.note: A milestone in capitals with a run of exclamation marks, followed by a joke about the absurd scale of what he will build to celebrate.

observations.trait: The hook is a premise with a big exact number, often written as a video title with a trade between task and prize.
Hype is a list of checkable superlatives ending in the feeling in capitals.
Gratitude compares the small beginning with the present scale and promises personal thanks.
Calls to action are exact: what to do, what you get, by when, and where to watch.
He talks openly about craft and asks the audience what they think.

illustration.brief: After eight months of building, we launch our app on Friday. It turns voice notes into a to-do list. Free for the first month.
illustration.text: We spent 8 MONTHS building an app and it launches this Friday!! You literally just talk and it turns your voice notes into a to-do list :D First month is free, go try it and tell me what you think!!
